candidates.file: File:Chief Hopes of 1925 Southern Conference Basketball Tourney.jpg
candidates.description: Caption text says "Here are representatives from five of the teams entered in the Southern Conference Basketball Tournament Which starts at the Auditorium. Left to right, Sikes, forward of Mississippi A&M; Wycoff, center and guard of Tech; Propst, guard and center of Alabama, Richardson, forward of Georgia, and Wallace McKinney, guard of Auburn."

candidates.description: The Auburn University men's basketball team tours the U.S. Naval Academy. The Veterans Classic brings top NCAA teams to the academy to kick off the college basketball season in an event that pays tribute to the nation's military veterans.
